correctness.rationale: A common global reset couples all initial states and yields the invariant renewal mixture. The voter generator gives the exact one-point decay and off-diagonal two-point recurrence with boundary C_0=1. Solving its bounded homogeneous/alternating forced components yields the infinite chain and finite even-ring laws, whose connected covariance is obtained by subtracting the exact mean product. The polynomial F_k(q) has exactly one root by strict monotonicity and the Lambert law follows from a controlled logarithmic expansion. Full 20-instance independent-generator numerical tests and 1,500 recurrence checks pass, but finite checks are supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The common-age term creates persistent staggered connected spin correlations despite microscopic nearest-neighbor voter copying. A sharp, strictly ordered threshold occurs at every odd separation of at least three, with exact q-polynomial roots and the nontrivial W(2k)^2/k^2 rate scale. Exact finite-cycle correlations give a meaningful independent simulation benchmark and isolate common-clock physics from local-reset models.
